# Narrative @ Stage 13 — Systematic Green

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Expression on this line

Narrative capacity at Order 12 is multi-paradigm narrative coordination: holding structuralist,
post-constructivist, cognitive, and indigenous narrative frameworks in productive tension
without collapsing to one. The defining capacity is that the narrative thinker can hold
multiple plot paradigms simultaneously without needing to declare a single winner.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** comfort holding multiple narrative paradigms as each partially valid.
- **UR:** the capacity to reason productively within multiple plot frameworks.
- **LL:** a narrative culture that values pluralism — multiple plot traditions coexisting and
  informing each other.
- **LR:** the institutional structures that support narrative pluralism.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** narrative relativism — holding so many paradigms that no coherent
  narrative emerges.
- **Dark allergy:** narrative lock — remaining committed to a single plot tradition as the
  only legitimate lens.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have constructed a narrative metatheory (Stage 14) while
  actually just holding paradigms in pluralistic tension.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to evaluate which narrative paradigms are more adequate.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Multi-paradigm narrative reasoning:** the thinker reasons productively within multiple
  plot frameworks.
- **Cross-cultural plot fluency:** the individual demonstrates appreciation across multiple
  narrative traditions.
- **Non-adjudicating comparison:** narrative paradigms are compared without declaring a single
  winner.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Bakhtin, *The Dialogic Imagination* (narrative as multi-paradigmatic); Ryan,
*Narrative as Virtual Reality* (narrative paradigms as virtual worlds).
**Open joints:** How does narrative pluralism shade into narrative metatheory (Stage 14)?
